native.nativeExtensionScope: Six exact official component archives and sixteen selected GNU ARM64 compiler, driver, host and foreign standard-library artifacts; system libraries, Cargo configuration, generated content, publisher and whole dependency closure remain outside this selection.

originalDefectRepairObservations.description: Reached native Rust build descendants were terminated but their actual build directory outlived the engine temporary directory. The original lifecycle callback failed its missing-directory assertion; the repaired commands place native build output inside engine-owned per-command storage and retain passing reached cancellation, timeout and output controls.

Successful native test witnesses change an owned selected executable copy both by appending a byte and by flipping one byte without changing its size. Stable project source cannot hide the post-witness tool change. Removing the actual SHA comparison or post-witness check produces a named assertion failure in the compiling-control harness.

physicalOutputsOmittedReason: Synthetic diagnostics contain workstation paths; only immutable hashes and bounded outcome accounting are published.
installedArtifactScope: The recorded tarball was evaluated before this measurement and status/inventory receipt declarations were emitted. Compiled engine and original callback bytes remain those evaluated; final Gate A package/matrix acceptance is separate.
